name: Image Search
description: Show pictures from the web in the chat: search for pictures of something (query), or show one picture whose address you found on a page (url). The server fetches them and serves copies from its own site, so they show in every client. Gives Image: lines to put in your reply.
author: anything

examples.prompt: What does a red panda look like?
Show me the photo from that article

query.description: What to find pictures of, e.g. 'red panda'. Leave empty when giving url.

url.description: The address of one picture (a .jpg, .png, .gif or .webp) to show instead of searching.

alt.description: What the picture at url shows, in a few words.
